message.content:
**Your 7‑Day Paris Adventure – A Complete Trip Plan**

| Day | Time | Activity | Notes |
|-----|------|----------|-------|
| **Day 1** | **Morning** | Arrive in Paris (Charles de Gaulle or Orly) | Take the RER B or a private shuttle to your hotel. |
| | **Afternoon** | Check‑in & settle | Hotel in the 7th (Eiffel Tower), 4th (Marais), or 8th (Champs‑Élysées) for easy access. |
| | **Evening** | Seine River Cruise | Classic “Bateaux Mouches” dinner cruise (≈ €60). | 
| **Day 2** | **Morning** | Louvre Museum | Arrive early (9 am) to beat crowds. Buy a “Louvre Pass” (≈ €30) for skip‑the‑line. |
| | **Afternoon** | Tuileries Garden & Place de la Concorde | Stroll, photo ops, coffee at Angelina. |
| | **Evening** | Dinner in Le Marais | Try “L’As du Fallafel” or “Café Charlot”. |
| **Day 3** | **Morning** | Eiffel Tower | Book “Skip‑the‑Line” tickets (≈ €25). |
| | **Afternoon** | Champ de Mars & Musée d’Orsay | Walk across the Seine, visit Impressionist masterpieces. |
| | **Evening** | Montmartre | Explore Sacré‑Coeur, artists’ square, dinner at “Le Consulat”. |
| **Day 4** | **Morning** | Day trip to Versailles | Take the RER C (≈ €7.50 each way). Guided tour optional (≈ €20). |
| | **Afternoon** | Gardens & Hall of Mirrors | Rent a bike or take a boat ride on the Grand Canal. |
| | **Evening** | Return to Paris | Relax at your hotel or enjoy a quiet café. |
| **Day 5** | **Morning** | Latin Quarter & Panthéon | Walk through historic streets, visit the Panthéon. |
| | **Afternoon** | Luxembourg Gardens | Picnic (buy baguette, cheese, wine). |
| | **Evening** | Opera Garnier | Book a performance or take a guided tour (≈ €15). |
| **Day 6** | **Morning** | Shopping on Rue Saint‑Honoré & Galeries Lafayette | Window‑shop, try the rooftop terrace at Galeries. |
| | **Afternoon** | Canal Saint‑Martin | Explore cafés, boutiques, and street art. |
| | **Evening** | Dinner cruise on the Seine (alternative) or “Le Jules Verne” (Eiffel Tower restaurant, ≈ €200). |
| **Day 7** | **Morning** | Free time / last‑minute shopping | Pick up souvenirs, revisit favorite spots. |
| | **Afternoon** | Pack & check‑out | Head to the airport via RER B or shuttle. |

---

## 1. Travel & Transportation

| Item | Details | Approx. Cost |
|------|---------|--------------|
| **Flights** | Round‑trip from your home city to Paris CDG/Orly | €200–€600 (depending on season & airline) |
| **Airport Transfer** | RER B (≈ €10) or private shuttle (≈ €30) | €10–€30 |
| **Public Transport** | 48‑hour Navigo pass (covers metro, RER, buses) | €22.80 |
| **Taxi/Uber** | For late‑night or heavy luggage | €15–€30 per ride |
| **Day Trips** | Versailles RER C (round‑trip) | €7.50 |
| **Museum Pass** | 3‑day Paris Pass (includes metro & museum entry) | €60–€70 |

> **Tip:** Buy a **Paris Pass** or **Paris Museum Pass** online in advance for savings and skip‑the‑line benefits.

---

## 2. Accommodation (Mid‑Range)

| Hotel | Location | Approx. Price/night | Highlights |
|-------|----------|---------------------|------------|
| **Hotel Le Six** | 6th Arrondissement | €180 | Boutique, near Luxembourg Gardens |
| **Hotel Henriette** | 4th Arrondissement | €170 | Charming, close to Notre‑Dame |
| **Hotel Ekta** | 8th Arrondissement | €190 | Near Champs‑Élysées, stylish décor |
| **Hotel La Maison** | 7th Arrondissement | €200 | Near Eiffel Tower, modern amenities |

> **Booking Tips:** Reserve via Booking.com or Hotels.com; look for free cancellation. Check for “Breakfast included” to save on meals.

---

## 3. Dining & Food

| Meal | Suggested Spots | Approx. Cost |
|------|-----------------|--------------|
| **Breakfast** | Café de Flore, Ladurée | €10–€15 |
| **Lunch** | Le Relais de l’Entrecôte (steak), L’As du Fallafel | €12–€18 |
| **Dinner** | Le Jules Verne (Eiffel Tower), Septime (modern French) | €70–€120 |
| **Dessert** | Angelina (hot chocolate), Pierre Hermé | €8–€12 |
| **Snacks** | Crêperie, street vendors | €3–€5 |

> **Tip:** Try a **bistro lunch** (often cheaper than dinner) and a **wine tasting** at a local bar.

---

## 4. Budget Breakdown (Per Person)

| Category | Approx. Cost |
|----------|--------------|
| Flights | €300 |
| Accommodation (7 nights) | €1,260 |
| Transport (airport + metro) | €70 |
| Food & Drinks | €350 |
| Attractions & Tours | €250 |
| Miscellaneous (souvenirs, tips) | €100 |
| **Total** | **≈ €2,430** |

> Adjust based on your preferences (luxury vs. budget).

---

## 5. Packing Checklist

| Category | Items |
|----------|-------|
| **Clothing** | Comfortable walking shoes, layers (Paris can be cool), umbrella, dressy outfit for dinner |
| **Electronics** | Phone, charger, power adapter (Type C/F), camera |
| **Travel Docs** | Passport, visa (if needed), travel insurance, copies of reservations |
| **Health** | Medications, basic first aid kit, hand sanitizer |
| **Misc** | Reusable water bottle, small daypack, guidebook or offline map app |

---

## 6. Safety & Etiquette

- **Language:** Basic French phrases help; most Parisians speak English in tourist areas.
- **Pickpockets:** Keep wallets in front pockets, use a money belt.
- **Tipping:** 5–10 % in restaurants; round up for taxi fares.
- **Public Transport:** Validate your ticket before boarding; fines are high.
- **Dining:** Wait for the waiter to seat you; “Bonjour” before ordering.

---

## 7. Optional Add‑Ons

| Activity | Why It’s Worth It | Approx. Cost |
|----------|------------------|--------------|
| **Wine & Cheese Tasting** | Experience French gastronomy | €40–€60 |
| **Seine Sunset Picnic** | Romantic & scenic | €30–€50 |
| **Day Trip to Giverny** (Monet’s Garden) | Art & nature | €70 |
| **Cooking Class** | Learn to make croissants or coq au vin | €80–€120 |

---

### Final Checklist Before Departure

1. **Confirm all reservations** (hotel, flights, tours).
2. **Check travel advisories** and weather forecast.
3. **Set up a local SIM** or ensure roaming is enabled.
4. **Print or download** copies of itineraries and tickets.
5. **Notify your bank** of travel dates to avoid card blocks.

Enjoy your Paris adventure! If you’d like more details on any specific day, dining options, or alternative itineraries, just let me know. Bon voyage!
